english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for deliberate hand or body contact, including brief, threatening, or sexual touching.
Use this for physically touching something or feeling around for an object by touch.
Use this when handle means touch or feel something with the hand rather than wield it.

examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 lyun6 mo2 ngo5 di1 je5

examples.english: I can feel that the table is still wet.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mo2 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 zung6 hai6 sap1 ge3

examples.english: Be careful, don’t handle the wound.
examples.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 mo2 go3 soeng1 hau2
